description.value:
You summon a viper from Ryūchi Cave. The summon arrives in an unoccupied 5-foot square within 30 feet and acts as a Small minion under your control for 1 minute.

The snake has 2 actions per turn, AC 18, 20 HP, and a fanged Strike at +10 dealing 1d4+2 piercing plus 1d4 persistent poison damage (basic Fort DC 17). It can Climb at full Speed and gains a +2 status bonus to Stealth checks made in undergrowth.

Heightened (+2) Each rank summons a more dangerous serpent; damage and poison rider scale.

system.requirements: you have signed the Snake summoning contract
